exemptions.description: Owner-occupied properties of 1-3 units where an owner of record resides in one unit as primary residence
exemptions.quote: Owner-occupied properties (between 1-3 units) in which an owner of record resides in one of the units as their primary residence

exemptions.description: Lifetime sex offenders; limited Section 8/public housing exemptions; owner move-back units; existing tenants subletting or adding roommates

key_values.name: administrative fine
key_values.text: at least $1,000 and up to $10,000 per violation

rules.penalty: Administrative fines of at least $1,000 and up to $10,000 per violation, civil damages including actual damages or three times one month's rent, punitive damages, attorneys' fees and costs, and injunctive relief.
rules.quote: The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.
rules.requirement: Rental housing providers may not ask about or use criminal history in advertising, applications, tenant selection, or decisions. Landlords taking action based on criminal history must give written notice and an opportunity to respond.
rules.title: Berkeley Fair Chance Access to Housing
